summary: A runtime ADAPTER for Claude Code: the one published declaration that carries this product's name, and nothing else. It is an ORDINARY capability (ADR-004, ADR-014) -- a host takes it through the provenance door (ADR-008) exactly as it takes a doctrine bundle, and no interpreter in the kit knows that it exists. Its single document keeps the runtime-surface contract, which is how the kit's served projection finds it: by the contract, never by a list of publishers. Remove it and the host serves this product nothing -- and says so.
